title: Pew
summary: PEW, noun [Latin podium.] An inclosed seat in a church. Pews were formerly made square; in modern churches in America they are generally long and narrow, and sometimes called slips. PEW, verb transiti

inlines.v: PEW, noun [Latin podium.] An inclosed seat in a church. Pews were formerly made square; in modern churches in America they are generally long and narrow, and sometimes called slips. PEW, verb transitive To furnish with pews. [Little used.]
